key_insight: Applying Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a decompositional verifiable reward lets AR-Diffusion Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) internally perform reasoning-driven text-to-image generation and autonomous self-refinement—without an extra cold-start stage.
problem_solved: Enables UMMs to infer implicit user intents and iteratively diagnose and correct their multimodal outputs, addressing limited reasoning and costly cold-start or auxiliary training phases.
method: Integrate GRPO into AR-Diffusion UMMs to optimize generation policies at the group/sequence level rather than per-token, improving global coherence.
Design decompositional verifiable rewards that break complex generation goals into checkable sub-rewards, enabling reliable credit assignment and self-reflective feedback.
Train end-to-end so the model can perform reasoning text-to-image inference and autonomously refine outputs without separate cold-start or external controllers.
impact: Practitioners get more capable, self-improving multimodal generators that reduce additional engineering/training overhead and improve intentful image synthesis and iterative correction workflows.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: AR-Diffusion model + GRPO loop with decompositional reward signals feeding back into generator
Before/After example panel: raw text prompt → initial image → model-inferred intent → refined image
Reward decomposition schematic: high-level objective split into verifiable sub-rewards with pass/fail checks
Bar/line chart: ablation comparing performance and cold-start cost with/without AlphaGRPO
paper_title: AlphaGRPO: Unlocking Self-Reflective Multimodal Generation in UMMs via Decompositional Verifiable Reward
paper_authors: Runhui Huang, Jie Wu, Rui Yang, Zhe Liu, Hengshuang Zhao
